Mate 'motor-input' swung 46.9° from rest in 0.5 s under gravity. It is a free passive joint (no actuator, no declared load), so this is informational, not a defect — declared limitsDeg / limitsMm are end stops, not a holding requirement. If 'motor-input' must HOLD its pose (a stay, a detent, a lid that stays open), declare it and the drop test will fail it when it sags: give the mate a load rating — arm.mate('motor-input', a, b, type, { limitsDeg, capacity: { envelope: { maxResultantForceN, maxResultantMomentNmm } } }) — or a load case — arm.physicalUseCase('<name>', { stableParts: ['<base>'], loads: [{ part: '<moving part>', force: [0, 0, -<N>] }] }); a motor-held joint is arm.mechanicalJoint(...), a spring-balanced one arm.tendon(...).
